name: Genealogy
description: Genealogy is a modern, private, self-hosted web application for building, exploring, and preserving a family tree archive with living-person privacy protection, Slavic patronymics, and zero-proxy native port 80 web serving.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>:80 in your browser to complete the First-Run Setup Wizard (create admin account, set passkey/password, and name your family tree).
To update to the latest release in the future, simply run 'update' inside the container console.
